claims.summary: Setup continues directly from Materials into generation with no teacher approval checkpoint.
The exact-input blueprint and signed approval remain mandatory internal generation authority.
A non-authorizable internal plan fails generation instead of becoming a teacher confirmation.
Retired-checkpoint projects resume automatically and all setup surfaces describe the same three-step journey.

boundaries: This contract records a locally verified predeploy candidate; remote CI, production deployment, and live re-audit are downstream facts.
The patch changes setup orchestration, recovery, and presentation; it does not change model weights, evidence admission, compiler schemas, exporters, or grading policy.
Internal plan authorization remains an engineering integrity mechanism and does not imply instructor approval or classroom validation.
Automated checks do not substitute for factual certification, accessibility certification, instructor evaluation, or classroom outcomes.
